about: The drill_power track's rig-look parts (ticket 875, LK12 of the P1-P5 map #647): one asset at the track's attach slot, the drill housing (the GD's drill_power showcase point on #180), one part per look step from the band edge of 60 LK1 (#809) froze for the line to 126, about P40 on the median path. #554's nine glow rows keep the first nine edges (6 to 54) with no part; each step here is the housing with one more part fitted in a socket on the gimbal drive's drum: the steam fittings first (a pressure gauge, a relief valve, the steam feed, cooling fins, a clamp band, a power flywheel), then heavier hardware (hex bolts, iron ribs, copper coils), then the aether glows (sight lenses, a flywheel halo, the aether housing). The names are the data strings of 3 words or fewer the hover line shows; the wiring reads thresholds and names from rigLook.json (#577), not from here. lookBoxM is the box every look fits inside, in the vehicle frame: the drum's face the tier-2 and tier-3 bow armour (z 5) and the headlamp (z 4) leave open, what the readability sheet measures a step over.
